map.统计字数、行数、话题数，支持 1000 字上限提醒。: Count characters, lines and hashtags, with a 1000-character limit reminder.
map.小红书字数统计：标题与正文分别按字素簇计数（1 个 emoji 记 1 个字），: Xiaohongshu counting: the title and body are counted separately by grapheme cluster (one emoji counts as one character); the title limit is 20 characters and the body default is 1000. Lines = non-empty lines, hashtags = tags starting with # or ＃; remaining allowance = limit − characters, and exceeding it triggers a warning.
map.发布前检查标题是否超过 20 字、正文是否接近 1000 字上限。: Check before publishing whether the title exceeds 20 characters or the body is near the 1000-character limit.
map.统计正文里的话题标签数量（# 与全角 ＃ 均计入），避免标签过多或漏加。: Count the hashtags in the body (# and full-width ＃ both count) so you neither over-tag nor miss any.
map.含 emoji 的文案按字素簇计数，避免按 UTF-16 码元把表情算成多个字而: Copy containing emoji is counted by grapheme cluster, so emoji are not counted as several characters by UTF-16 code units and falsely reported as over the limit.
map.标题「秋日通勤穿搭｜三件基础款」12 字 → 标题剩余 8 字；正文 620 字: The title "Autumn commute outfit | three basics" is 12 characters, leaving 8; a 620-character body against a 1000 limit leaves 380; with 10 lines and 5 hashtags the status is "OK". Lower the limit to 500 and the same body reports "body over by 120".
map.「👨‍👩‍👧‍👦」是 4 个表情用零宽连接符组合，UTF-16 长度为 11；按: "👨‍👩‍👧‍👦" combines four emoji with zero-width joiners and is 11 UTF-16 code units long, but counts as one grapheme. Three such emoji count as 3 characters while the UTF-16 figure shows 33; comparing the two explains platform-side differences.
map.计数能替代平台后台吗？: Can counting replace the platform backend?
map.不能。平台编辑器有自己的字数口径，本工具按字素簇给出接近用户感知的估算，发布前仍: No. The platform editor has its own counting rules; this tool gives a grapheme-based estimate close to what users perceive, but the editor's warning prevails before publishing.
map.半角 # 与全角 ＃ 都会识别，重复标签按出现次数累计；标签中间的 # 会作为分: Both half-width # and full-width ＃ are recognised, repeated tags accumulate by occurrence, and a # inside a tag acts as a separator.
map.emoji 为什么按 1 个字算？: Why do emoji count as one character?
map.一个表情可能由多个码元与零宽连接符组成，按字素簇计数更接近「肉眼看到几个字」；结: An emoji may consist of several code points and zero-width joiners; grapheme counting is closer to what the eye sees as one character. The result card also keeps the UTF-16 count for technical cross-checks.
